message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **50,000 total casualties** when you combine the losses of both sides:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch‑Hessian, Prussian) | ~25,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary reports and modern scholarship. The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but most historians agree that the combined toll was around half a million people affected (including those who were wounded but survived).
